violations.title: Cooling from 135F to 41F, No More than 6 Hours
violations.observation: The following cooked time/temperature control for safety food(s) are not being adequately cooled from 135F to 70F within two hours and to 41F within a total of six hours. Chili beans, Marinara sauce. Observed temperatures after 6 hours were as follow=chili beans=46F, marinara said ice = 47F, at there walk-in refrigerator.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety foods shall be cooled from 135F to 70F within two hours and to 41F within a total of six hours to prevent the growth of harmful bacteria. Foods that have been temperature abused are to be discarded. CORRECTED DURING THE INSPECTION.

violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device:Two trays of chicken kabobs were not red as follows: 121F, 120F.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. CORRECTED DURING THE INSPECTION. (REHEATED)

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Food stored on the floor and/or food stored less than 6 inches off the floor. Two trays of chicken kabobs were found stored on the floor, in the walk-in freezer.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage. CORRECTED DURING THE INSPECTION.

violations.title: Plumbing System, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: The sink basin at the Bar hand washing sink, is slow to drain. Also, one of the two urinals in the mem’s restroom is not working,
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be maintained in good repair. Unclog this hand washing sink for proper operation and repair the urinal.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: Observed that the ceiling tiles in the basement storage area are missing at some locations and some of the tiles are water/moisture damaged.
violations.corrective_action: Repair the physical facilities. Poor repair and maintenance compromises the functionality of the physical facilities. Replace the damaged and missing ceiling tiles to protect single service utensils and other food and food contact equipment from contamination by dust from the exposed rafters.
